## What do you want

A clear description of the feature.

## Why does it matter

What problem does this solve? What's the use case?

## Proposed implementation (optional)

If you have a design in mind — tool spec, CLI flag, behavior change, etc.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about and why did you reject them?
